title: Kintsugi Card
description: A status card repaired in gold: the cracks of an incident, drawn as kintsugi veins that mend on arrival.
usage: Kintsugi is the craft of repairing broken pottery with gold — the break becomes the most valuable part. This card reports an incident the same way: what broke, how long it took, and the veins drawn across the surface as the record, gilded instead of hidden. The mend animates on arrival; hover draws it again. For status pages and postmortems that intend to be believed.
a11y: The facts are text — status, downtime, data loss — in a normal card; the veins are canvas decoration above it. Under prefers-reduced-motion the veins are drawn complete and still: repaired is repaired, animated or not.
